what: Chevron is one of the largest integrated oil companies: it finds and produces oil and gas worldwide (upstream) and refines and sells fuels and chemicals (downstream). It acquired Hess in 2025.
customers: Refiners, utilities, industrial users, drivers at Chevron and Texaco stations, and chemical buyers.
money: Permian Basin, Kazakhstan (Tengiz), Australia LNG, Guyana via Hess
moat: Low-cost reserves, scale and a strong balance sheet that supports dividends through cycles.
